clues.title: Camels in a cold desert
clues.text: Double-humped Bactrian camels walk among the sand dunes of Nubra Valley. Which union territory hides this unexpected meeting of desert and mountains?

clues.title: A festival behind monastery walls
clues.text: At Hemis, masked dancers take part in a Buddhist monastery festival. Which high-altitude union territory is home to this tradition?

clues.title: Leh is your signpost
clues.text: Leh, Pangong Lake and the stark landscapes around the Indus are some of its best-known sights. Which union territory are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: Nubra Valley is a cold desert: sand dunes and high mountains can belong to the same landscape.

clues.title: An elusive deer
clues.text: Dachigam National Park protects the hangul, a rare deer. In which union territory would you find it?

clues.title: Threads and flowers
clues.text: Think of fine pashmina shawls and the saffron fields around Pampore. Which union territory brings these two traditions together?

clues.title: A lake full of shikaras
clues.text: Srinagar’s Dal Lake is famous for its shikaras and houseboats. Name this union territory.

questions.takeaway: Pampore is closely associated with saffron cultivation, while Dachigam is a refuge for the hangul.

clues.title: A monastery in the cold desert
clues.text: Tabo Monastery stands in the stark mountain landscape of Spiti. Which state would you travel to for this ancient Buddhist monastery?

clues.title: A home in the hills
clues.text: Dharamshala and nearby McLeod Ganj are closely associated with the Dalai Lama and Tibetan culture. Which state are you in?

clues.title: Follow the mountain railway
clues.text: Shimla is its capital and Manali is one of its most popular mountain towns. Which state connects these familiar destinations?

questions.takeaway: The state contains very different mountain environments, from green hill towns to the cold desert of Spiti.

clues.title: Sport beyond the stadium
clues.text: The rural sports festival at Kila Raipur brings unusual contests and athletic traditions to a village near Ludhiana. Which state hosts it?

clues.title: A harvest in motion
clues.text: Bhangra and the spring festival of Baisakhi are deeply associated with this state’s farming culture. Which state comes to mind?

clues.title: An unmistakable golden landmark
clues.text: Amritsar’s Golden Temple is one of its most famous landmarks. Which state are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: Kila Raipur’s sports festival is often nicknamed the Rural Olympics.

clues.title: An open hand
clues.text: A giant Open Hand monument expresses the idea of being open to give and receive. Which city and union territory uses it as an emblem?

clues.title: Art made from the discarded
clues.text: Nek Chand transformed broken objects and discarded materials into the extraordinary Rock Garden. Which union territory is home to it?

clues.title: One city, two capitals
clues.text: This planned city and union territory serves as the shared capital of two neighbouring northern states. Can you name it?

questions.takeaway: Chandigarh’s Rock Garden turns discarded everyday materials into sculpture and architecture.

clues.title: A city beneath the soil
clues.text: Archaeologists at Rakhigarhi study one of the major settlements of the Harappan civilisation. Which state contains this ancient site?

clues.title: A battlefield in the history books
clues.text: Panipat, remembered for three major battles, lies in this state. Which state links this historic city with Kurukshetra?

clues.title: A modern skyline
clues.text: Gurugram, once commonly called Gurgaon, is here. Which state contains this major business hub?

questions.takeaway: Rakhigarhi offers a glimpse of urban life thousands of years before Gurugram’s modern skyline.

clues.title: Steps beneath the city
clues.text: Agrasen ki Baoli is a historic stepwell tucked into a busy urban landscape. In which union territory would you descend its stone steps?

clues.title: A poet’s old address
clues.text: The haveli of Urdu poet Mirza Ghalib stands in Ballimaran, in the old city. Which union territory holds this literary landmark?

clues.title: The nation’s capital
clues.text: The Red Fort, India Gate and the Qutub Minar are all here. Which national capital territory are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: The city’s stepwells were water infrastructure long before they became heritage attractions.

clues.title: Patterns at the threshold
clues.text: Aipan, a ceremonial folk-art tradition of Kumaon, often uses white designs on a red ground. Which Himalayan state is its home?

clues.title: Protecting a forest
clues.text: Gaura Devi and the women of Reni are remembered for their role in the Chipko movement. In which present-day state is their village?

clues.title: A river and two sacred towns
clues.text: Haridwar and Rishikesh sit along the Ganga in this state, whose capital is Dehradun. Which state is it?

questions.takeaway: Aipan is a living art tradition, used for rituals and special occasions in Kumaon.

clues.title: Dance with a serpent’s rhythm
clues.text: Kalbelia dancers are known for flowing movements and swirling black skirts. This UNESCO-recognised tradition belongs to which state?

clues.title: A warrior of Mewar
clues.text: Maharana Pratap and the history of Mewar are closely tied to this state. Which state are we tracing?

clues.title: Think pink, then think desert
clues.text: Jaipur, the Pink City, is its capital, and the Thar Desert stretches across much of its west. Name the state.

questions.takeaway: Kalbelia music and dance carry the community’s knowledge and stories through performance.

clues.title: A palace that goes down
clues.text: Rani ki Vav at Patan is a richly carved stepwell rather than a palace above ground. Which state contains this UNESCO World Heritage Site?

clues.title: Where a familiar story began
clues.text: Mahatma Gandhi was born in Porbandar and established his famous ashram beside the Sabarmati. Which state links these places?

clues.title: Lions and a towering statue
clues.text: Gir’s Asiatic lions and the Statue of Unity are two of its best-known attractions. Which state are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: Rani ki Vav shows how a functional water structure could also become an intricate work of art.

clues.title: A lake made by an impact
clues.text: Lonar Lake fills a crater formed by a meteorite impact. In which state would you find this unusual landscape?

clues.title: A rhythm with a story
clues.text: Lavani combines expressive performance with the beat of the dholki. Which state is especially associated with this tradition?

clues.title: A gateway beside the sea
clues.text: Mumbai, the Gateway of India and much of the Hindi film industry are here. Which state are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: Lonar’s crater is a striking reminder that India’s landscapes have also been shaped by events from space.

questions.answer: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

clues.title: A shrine beside the waves
clues.text: Near Fudam village, the Gangeshwar Temple sits beside the sea. Which present-day union territory contains this coastal shrine?

clues.title: A fort on the coast
clues.text: A coastal fort with Portuguese-era heritage stands in this union territory. Which territory combines western coastal enclaves with an inland district?

clues.title: Two territories become one
clues.text: Silvassa is part of this union territory, formed by merging two territories in 2020. Can you name it?

questions.takeaway: The present-day union territory brings together geographically separated areas on India’s western side.

sources.label: Explore Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

clues.title: Stone that seems to sing
clues.text: At Hampi’s Vittala Temple, pillars are famous for their musical qualities. Which state holds these remains of the Vijayanagara capital?

clues.title: A city lights up
clues.text: Mysuru Dasara fills a palace city with celebration, processions and lights. Which state is home to this festival?

clues.title: A familiar tech address
clues.text: Bengaluru is its capital, while Mysuru and Hampi are among its famous destinations. Which state is it?

questions.takeaway: Hampi’s monuments preserve the history of Vijayanagara beside a remarkable landscape of granite boulders.

clues.title: An art that transforms the performer
clues.text: In Theyyam, elaborate costume, make-up and ritual performance create a striking sacred art. With which state’s northern districts is it closely associated?

clues.title: Stories told through eyes and hands
clues.text: Kathakali performers use detailed make-up, expressive eyes and hand gestures to tell epic stories. Which state is its home?

clues.title: Follow the backwaters
clues.text: Alappuzha’s houseboats and the backwaters are famous here. Thiruvananthapuram is its capital. Which state are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: Theyyam and Kathakali are distinct performance traditions; they should not be treated as the same art form.

clues.title: A forest with waterways for paths
clues.text: At Pichavaram, boats pass through waterways among mangrove roots. Which state contains this coastal forest near Chidambaram?

clues.title: A classical language of movement
clues.text: Bharatanatyam grew from this state’s performance traditions. Which state is known for this classical dance form?

clues.title: A capital by a long beach
clues.text: Chennai and its Marina Beach are here, alongside the temple cities of Madurai and Thanjavur. Which state is it?

questions.takeaway: Mangrove forests such as Pichavaram create habitat where land and sea meet.

clues.title: A pillar with a surprise
clues.text: Lepakshi’s Veerabhadra Temple is famous for a pillar that appears not to rest fully on the floor. Which state contains this architectural curiosity?

clues.title: A village gives a dance its name
clues.text: Kuchipudi, one of India’s classical dance forms, takes its name from a village in this state. Which state is it?

clues.title: A celebrated pilgrimage
clues.text: Tirupati and the hill temple of Sri Venkateswara at Tirumala are here. Which state are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: Lepakshi is also known for its monumental Nandi sculpture.

clues.title: A temple with lightweight bricks
clues.text: The Ramappa Temple is known for its intricate carving and lightweight bricks. Which state contains this UNESCO-listed Kakatiya monument?

clues.title: Flowers arranged for a festival
clues.text: Bathukamma celebrates with layered arrangements of seasonal flowers and women gathering to sing and dance. Which state is especially associated with it?

clues.title: Four minarets in a famous city
clues.text: Hyderabad’s Charminar is its best-known landmark. Which state, formed in 2014, has Hyderabad as its capital?

questions.takeaway: Ramappa Temple is named after the sculptor associated with its creation, an unusual distinction for a temple.

clues.title: A trading port beneath the ground
clues.text: Arikamedu is an archaeological site associated with ancient maritime trade near this union territory’s main city. Which territory is it?

clues.title: An ashram and a thinker
clues.text: Sri Aurobindo’s ashram is one of its best-known institutions. Which union territory is home to this spiritual community?

clues.title: A French quarter beside the sea
clues.text: White Town, French street names and the seafront Promenade give its main city a distinctive character. Which union territory is it?

questions.takeaway: Puducherry is a union territory whose separate districts are spread across different parts of southern India.

clues.title: A lighthouse with a long view
clues.text: Minicoy’s lighthouse dates to 1885. Which island union territory would you visit to see this maritime landmark?

clues.title: Life around a lagoon
clues.text: Agatti and Bangaram are known for coral reefs and turquoise lagoons. Which union territory do these islands belong to?

clues.title: Coral islands in the west
clues.text: Kavaratti is its capital, and its coral islands lie in the Arabian Sea. Which union territory are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: Coral reefs are living ecosystems, not simply colourful rocks beneath clear water.

clues.title: An island that still erupts
clues.text: Barren Island is home to India’s active volcano. Which island union territory contains it?

clues.title: Walls that remember the freedom struggle
clues.text: The Cellular Jail stands as a memorial to those imprisoned during British rule. In which union territory is it located?

clues.title: An island chain in the east
clues.text: These islands lie off India’s eastern coast. Their capital, once called Port Blair, is now named Sri Vijaya Puram. Which union territory is it?

questions.takeaway: India’s island union territories sit in different seas: this one is in the Bay of Bengal, east of the mainland.

clues.title: A lake with a bubbling secret
clues.text: Netravali’s bubbling lake, also called Budbudyanchi Tali, is a little-known inland attraction. Which coastal state contains it?

clues.title: A basilica with a famous name
clues.text: The Basilica of Bom Jesus holds the relics of St Francis Xavier. Which state’s Portuguese-era heritage are we exploring?

clues.title: A small state with a long beach list
clues.text: Panaji is its capital, and Calangute, Baga and Palolem are well-known beaches. Which state is it?

questions.takeaway: There is much more to the state than its beaches: its inland villages, forests and heritage sites tell different stories.

clues.title: Paintings older than cities
clues.text: The rock shelters at Bhimbetka preserve ancient paintings. Which state holds this remarkable record of human life?

clues.title: A stupa on a hill
clues.text: Sanchi’s Great Stupa is one of India’s most celebrated Buddhist monuments. Which state would you visit to see it?

clues.title: In the heart of the map
clues.text: Bhopal is its capital and Khajuraho is one of its famous heritage destinations. Which central Indian state are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: Bhimbetka’s rock shelters and Sanchi’s monuments reveal very different periods of India’s past.

clues.title: Metal shaped by a disappearing mould
clues.text: Bastar is celebrated for Dhokra metalwork made using the lost-wax process. Which state contains this craft region?

clues.title: A river falls in a horseshoe
clues.text: Chitrakote Falls on the Indravati River is one of this state’s best-known natural sights. Which state is it?

clues.title: Raipur is the key
clues.text: Its capital is Raipur, and it became a separate state in 2000. Can you name it?

questions.takeaway: In lost-wax casting, a wax model helps create a mould and is removed before molten metal takes its place.

clues.title: A shore that becomes a nursery
clues.text: Olive ridley turtles gather for mass nesting along the Rushikulya coast. Which state protects this remarkable wildlife spectacle?

clues.title: Sculpture comes to life
clues.text: A classical dance form deeply associated with this state’s temples brings sculptural poses to life. Which state is it?

clues.title: A chariot made of stone
clues.text: Konark’s Sun Temple and Puri’s Jagannath Temple are famous landmarks here. Bhubaneswar is its capital. Name the state.

questions.takeaway: Mass nesting by olive ridley turtles is often called an arribada.

clues.title: A lily with a tiny home
clues.text: The Shirui lily grows naturally in the Shirui Hills of Ukhrul and is this state’s official flower. Which northeastern state is its home?

clues.title: A champion with a silver lift
clues.text: Weightlifter Mirabai Chanu, who won silver at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, comes from this state. Which state are we looking for?

clues.title: A graceful classical dance
clues.text: A graceful classical dance tradition here is known for Raas Leela performances. Which northeastern state is its home?

questions.takeaway: The Shirui lily is the state flower. Its natural home in the Shirui Hills makes protecting this habitat especially important.

clues.title: An island of monasteries
clues.text: Majuli, a river island in the Brahmaputra, is known for its satras and mask-making traditions. Which state is its home?

clues.title: Three celebrations of the farming year
clues.text: Rongali, Bhogali and Kongali are the three forms of Bihu. Which state’s agricultural calendar do these festivals celebrate?

clues.title: Tea, a river and a rhino
clues.text: Guwahati and Kaziranga National Park are here, in a state famous for tea and the one-horned rhinoceros. Which state is it?

questions.takeaway: A satra is a centre of the Neo-Vaishnavite religious and cultural tradition, not simply a tourist monument.

clues.title: A name you can sing
clues.text: In Kongthong, people use individual tunes as a way of calling one another. Which northeastern state contains this singing village?

clues.title: A bridge that keeps growing
clues.text: Khasi and Jaintia communities guide living tree roots into bridges. Which state is famous for these living root bridges?

clues.title: The capital above the clouds
clues.text: Shillong is its capital, while Cherrapunji and Mawsynram are famous for extraordinary rainfall. Which state are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: Living root bridges are grown and maintained over generations; they are living infrastructure.

clues.title: A sacred lake in the hills
clues.text: Khecheopalri Lake near Pelling is revered by both Buddhists and Hindus. Which Himalayan state would you travel to?

clues.title: A monastery near the capital
clues.text: Rumtek Monastery is a major Buddhist landmark near Gangtok. Which state is its home?

clues.title: A capital beneath a great mountain
clues.text: Gangtok is its capital, and Khangchendzonga is central to its landscape and culture. Which small Himalayan state is it?

questions.takeaway: The state’s lakes and mountains are not only scenic places; many also carry deep spiritual significance.

clues.title: Stories in terracotta
clues.text: Bishnupur’s temples are famous for their detailed terracotta decoration. Which state preserves this distinctive temple-town heritage?

clues.title: A poet and a place of learning
clues.text: Rabindranath Tagore’s Santiniketan is here. Which state is associated with this Nobel laureate and his educational vision?

clues.title: A bridge over the Hooghly
clues.text: Kolkata is its capital, and the Howrah Bridge is a familiar symbol of the city. Which state are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: Terracotta literally means baked earth: clay becomes a durable medium for architectural storytelling.

clues.title: Fish among the rice
clues.text: The Apatani people of Ziro are known for a farming system that combines wet-rice cultivation with fish. Which state contains their valley?

clues.title: A monastery in the mountains
clues.text: Tawang Monastery is one of this state’s most famous Buddhist landmarks. Which state would you travel to?

clues.title: A capital in the far northeast
clues.text: Itanagar is its capital, and it lies at the eastern edge of India’s Himalayan region. Which state is it?

questions.takeaway: The Ziro Valley shows how cultural knowledge and farming practices can shape a distinctive landscape.

clues.title: A village with a conservation story
clues.text: Khonoma is known for community-led conservation and is often called a green village. In which northeastern state would you find it?

clues.title: A festival named after a bird
clues.text: The Hornbill Festival brings together the cultures of many local communities. Which state hosts it?

clues.title: Kohima is your clue
clues.text: Kohima, remembered for a major Second World War battle, is its capital. Which state are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: Khonoma is an example of communities taking an active role in protecting their local environment.

clues.title: A waterfall in a green valley
clues.text: Vantawng Falls near Thenzawl is one of this state’s best-known natural attractions. Which northeastern state contains it?

clues.title: Dance between the bamboo
clues.text: In Cheraw, dancers step between moving bamboo poles. Which state is especially known for this performance tradition?

clues.title: Find Aizawl
clues.text: Aizawl is its capital. This hilly northeastern state shares international borders with Bangladesh and Myanmar. Which state is it?

questions.takeaway: Cheraw requires close coordination between the dancers and the people moving the bamboo poles.

clues.title: Faces carved into a hillside
clues.text: Unakoti is famous for monumental rock-cut figures, including images of Shiva. Which northeastern state holds this striking site?

clues.title: A palace in a lake
clues.text: Neermahal stands in Rudrasagar Lake, combining royal architecture with a waterside setting. Which state is it in?

clues.title: The capital is Agartala
clues.text: Agartala is its capital, and Bangladesh wraps around much of its boundary. Which state are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: Neermahal’s name means water palace, a fitting description of its setting in Rudrasagar Lake.

clues.title: A polished interior from the ancient world
clues.text: The Barabar caves are known for their ancient rock-cut chambers and highly polished walls. Which state contains these Mauryan-era caves?

clues.title: A tree in a world-changing story
clues.text: Bodh Gaya is revered as the place where the Buddha attained enlightenment. Which state would you visit?

clues.title: A capital and an ancient university
clues.text: Patna is its capital and Nalanda is one of its famous historic sites. Which state is it?

questions.takeaway: The Barabar caves and the remains of Nalanda connect the state to different chapters of ancient learning and belief.

clues.title: Paintings made from the earth
clues.text: Sohrai and Khovar paintings in the Hazaribagh region use locally available earth colours. Which state is home to this tradition?

clues.title: A leader remembered as Dharti Aba
clues.text: Birsa Munda is strongly associated with the region that became this state. Which state honours this tribal leader’s legacy?

clues.title: Ranchi and a city of steel
clues.text: Ranchi is its capital, and Jamshedpur is famous for its steel industry. Which state are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: Sohrai and Khovar art are linked to community life, including harvest and marriage traditions.

clues.title: A city that captures fragrance
clues.text: Kannauj is famous for traditional attar, or perfume, distilled using long-established techniques. Which state contains this fragrant city?

clues.title: A city beside the sacred river
clues.text: Varanasi’s ghats line the Ganga and draw pilgrims from across India. Which state is it in?

clues.title: A monument almost everyone knows
clues.text: Agra’s Taj Mahal is here, and Lucknow is the state capital. Which state are we looking for?

questions.takeaway: Attar-making turns flowers and other aromatic materials into concentrated fragrances with deep cultural associations.

retiredFacts.text: Head to India’s northeast, along the border with Myanmar. Imphal is its capital, and Loktak Lake is a famous landmark. Which state is it?
